name: lv_indev_get_point

ownership.argument: Borrowed live page-owned LVGL object/event/input device; output coordinate buffer borrowed for call; no retention.

provenance.source: Copies two signed DWORD coordinates from indev+56,+60 for pointer/button input. Null input writes zero; wrong type writes -1. Startup 0xc0c0ac8 copies [0x2c10d440,0x2c18d940) to PSRAM 0x3c000000, executable alias 0x1c000000; load address 0xc15e050 maps to runtime 0x1c050c10, callable 0x1c050c11. Exact runtime native callers include 0x1c06499c and 0x1c066e56.

notes: Target-private native UI host only. Static recovery does not grant public callable approval or device verification.
